LABEL: PMUS_BTC15M_UNDERDOG_PRICE_X_TIME_CALIBRATION
labels: One causal observation per window per checkpoint: the newest book state at or before the checkpoint. No window/checkpoint without such a quote is filled in from a midpoint, last trade, settlementPrice or later book state -- it is excluded and counted. The cheaper side's price IS its implied probability. Capacity is the DISPLAYED TOUCH only; the tape carries no ladder, so larger size is unknowable, and no market impact, queue position, partial fill or adverse selection is modelled. Nothing here is a filled, settled or realized number. The sizing model contains no loss-dependent term and is not a Martingale.
